gemini.performance_metric: no divestiture, impairment, or dissolution; facility completed and in operation
gemini.rationale: The slice documents that the distribution facility was successfully built, placed in operation, and leased to the registrant through 2031. There is no evidence of product/process disruption or process/organization fracture, as the venture remained a consolidated VIE with no documented divestiture, impairment, or dissolution during the outcome window.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture/impairment; facility retained, leased through 2031 at ~$11.3M/yr
grok.rationale: The slice documents that the distribution facility was completed, placed in operation, and leased to the registrant through 2031 at approximately $11.3 million per year, with the venture retained and consolidated and no impairment or dissolution reported (Form 10-K FY2014). Absence of any documented product/process misalignment or operations-versus-organization fracture over the ~5-year window yields p4_pathway=0 and p5_pathway=0.

openai.performance_metric: Facility completed and operating; retained and consolidated with no divestiture, impairment, or dissolution by year 5
openai.rationale: The facility was completed, placed in operation, and leased to the registrant through 2031, with no documented product/process-interface disruption. The venture remained consolidated and made partner distributions, while no divestiture, impairment, dissolution, or operations-versus-organization fracture was documented within the outcome window.
